candidate_serialization_scope: Actual full candidate JSON roundtrip/restore check executed in pinned scientific driver; record helper independently validates head recipe/identity, does not reconstruct entire source checkpoint again.

cost.scope: Single-run same-convex-FW-precision phase timing for49-parameter self-target problems; not task-quality,whole-study,inference,full-model-training,or repeated-benchmark speedup.

edit_scope: 49 existing Belief coefficients+bias per direct/PGD candidate relative to paired A or C; W1/core/decoder/continuation unchanged.
fit_data_scope: All and only original TRAIN hidden+bias and own bank7; independent H/probability source chain verified against previous TRAIN evidence.

output.scope: Scalar record arithmetic, source/parameter identity, exact registered-content dedup and recorded freeze chain only. Convex numerical-source verification is independently handled by verify_belief_solver_records.py; no global external-history freshness claim.

Independent scalar reconstruction of recorded objective/gradient/Gram/FW/KKT and exact stored-IEEE radius, with previously frozen TRAIN H and own-bank target provenance. Eigenvalues checked for L only; no new candidate solve or PGD replay. Numerical diagnostics are not rigorous outward-rounded real optimality certificates. Matching this small self-target objective does not establish full-model-training or task-quality equivalence.

measurement.endpoint: Before final results compression and qualification write;180CPU hard cap covers whole process.

metric_scope.belief_brier: Mean squared error against Oracle posterior, Brier excess risk excluding Bernoulli irreducible term; not observed label/trading Brier.
metric_scope.expected_utility: Complete finite-law policy expectation including original costs/observations; no FullHX/trading.
metric_scope.own_bank_logit_mse: Compilation target approximation only, distinct from truth, Bellman consistency and task value.

publication_scope: Public checkpoint-derived synthetic joint task inputs/results/edited heads; no newly private HeptaTrader data,account/order identifiers,host operation paths,original full model copies or transfer caches.
